result.summary: The missing-organization handling is correct, but the PR leaves the deterministic duplicate deletion in place. Remove the legacy deletion step and keep the idempotency protection for event retries.

problems.title: Root cause remains
problems.detail: The workspace deleter still deletes the organization before emitting an event whose handler deletes it again. The PR silences the resulting second-delete failure but retains the redundant WorkOS request.

problems.title: Description overstates the failure
problems.detail: The workspace row is deleted and the event emitted before the sync handler runs. It is the subscriber delivery that retries, not workspace deletion itself.

problems.title: Handler test can pass without deletion
problems.detail: The test only checks for an Ok result and does not assert that deleteOrganization received the expected ID or that a non-not-found error remains an error.

result.betterFix: Remove the WorkOS organization step from the workspace deleter so the event handler is the single owner. Retain the 404 handling because at-least-once delivery can still retry after a successful deletion.
